row.notes: (list, n): reserve the child pointer array of a property list: when n > u16 cap list+0x12, allocates n*8 via allocator list[0] vt+0x18, copies u16 count list+0x10 entries from list[1], frees the old array vt+0x38, sets cap; alloc failure returns 0xc, else 0. call sites. Better name: Ne_PropList_ReserveChildren (bound record keeps its name).

verify.notes: V10335 It is a capacity reserve for the pointer array (param is element count, *8 bytes; cap ushort at +0x12), returns 0xc on alloc failure; not a size-byte buffer.
